SEARCH
Package model

Class Student

java.lang.Object
model.User
model.Student
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Researcher
public class Student extends User implements Serializable, Researcher
Represents student in the university system. Student can: register for courses, view transcript and marks, rate teachers and participate in research activities. Students may also become researchers by publishing papers and joining projects.

    • requestCourseRegistration

      public boolean requestCourseRegistration(Course c) throws CreditLimitExceededException
      Sends request for course registration. Registration request will fail if: - registration is closed, - credit limit exceeds 21 credits, - student already requested this course.
      Parameters:
      c - target course
      Returns:
      true if request sent successfully
      Throws:
      CreditLimitExceededException - if credit limit exceeded

    • confirmCourseRegistration

      public void confirmCourseRegistration(Course c)

      public void incrementFailCount() throws MaxFailReachedException
      Increases fail counter. According to system rules, student is expelled after 3 failures.
      Throws:

    • assignSupervisor

      public void assignSupervisor(Researcher supervisor) throws LowHIndexException
      Assigns research supervisor to student. According to university rules: only 4th year students may have supervisors. Supervisor must also have h-index >= 3.
      Parameters:
      supervisor - assigned researcher
      Throws:
      LowHIndexException - if h-index is lower than 3
